title: A certified coordinate-gauge obstruction for causal-order reconstruction in a 2+1 diamond
description:
On the unit 2+1 Minkowski diamond, the established causal-diamond conformal flow transports normalized flat volume to a nonconstant smooth density between 1/2 and 3/2 with Euclidean Lipschitz constant at most two. Every finite labeled and unlabeled directed chronological-order law agrees with the flat law, while the coordinate supremum distance remains positive modulo every spatial orthogonal transformation. Nevertheless, the associated volume-normalized Lorentzian metrics are smoothly isometric, with an explicit pullback identity.

This separate technical preprint gives the construction and complete proofs, identifies the flow with its established conformal-field-theory formula, compares relevant order-law and reconstruction precedents, and maps the claims to accepted Lean 4 statements. Its contribution is an explicit certified density-class example and an audit of an insufficient coordinate gauge. It claims no new conformal flow, mathematical priority, higher-dimensional inverse rate or physical nonidentifiability. Formal and prose refinements are distinguished. The exact proof revision has remote GCP acceptance; the shared library audit covers 295 selected exports, not 295 results of this paper.

Author: Daniel Eric Fredriksen, Quantyra Inc. Developed with OpenAI Codex assistance. Open-source decentralized informal feedback and downstream use/testing remain the review workflow. Manuscript and source bundle: CC-BY-4.0. The separately linked proof software is Apache-2.0. This is a distinct manuscript with its own DOI and version history, separate from the reconstruction paper.
